battery.measurement_scope: Entire capture, including awake and suspend/resume overhead
battery.power_check_scope: Endpoints only; keep all external power disconnected throughout

assessment.interpretation: Software suspend completed, but high reported energy loss and rising endpoint temperatures support excessive suspend power. Frequent tick freeze/unfreeze activity differs sharply from the earlier low-drain run. This does not identify the interrupt or establish that periodic activity alone explains the power loss.

limitations: 26.18 seconds outside machine_suspend are included in energy loss.
Requested resume settling wait was six seconds, not sixty; final energy sample was about 13.7 seconds after lid-open. Gauge settling remains uncertain.
IRQ tracing was filtered to ACPI event IRQs 72 and 141. Other hardware interrupts, timers, and IPIs were not traced. Absence of filtered events does not imply no CPU activity.
Thermal readings are endpoints, not bag peak temperatures.
Whole-capture interrupt deltas mix awake and suspend activity and cannot identify the periodic wake source.
next_step: Instrument IRQ/timer/IPI activity during s2idle, correlate it with the half-second freeze/unfreeze cycle, and compare with the low-drain capture before selecting a driver or firmware fix.
